notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty, particularly on Void builds. Zealot's Reward is a rapid-fire fusion rifle, which are rated F-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being a "strict downgrade from high-impact and precision frames for boss damage". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Overload, better total ammo reserves and a ×0.8 reload animation scalar when the battery is empty as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are decent by comparison with its peers - you can see them at https://destiny.report/w/2720651699/zealots-reward and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/2720651699 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. With 9 bolts to control, look for a barrel perk that helps with recoil control together with any other stat that you want to bump. As the battery perk, Accelerated Coils improves charge time by 40ms at the cost of ×0.98 base damage, or Enhanced Battery gets you to the maximum of 8 shots. For synergising with Void builds and dealing with groups of Minor adds, in the first trait perk column Destabilizing Rounds spreads Void Volatility on a kill in a 6.5m radius and provides Volatile Rounds for 4.5s (5.25s when enhanced). In the second column, Dimensional Shift grants Dimensional Breach on picking up a Void Breach - while active, a kill provides a refreshable 8s overshield. Alternatively, One For All boosts damage by ×1.35 for a non-refreshable 10s (11s when enhanced) after hitting three separate targets within 3s of each. The Photoinhibition origin trait is excellent in PvE, boosting shield, overshield and barrier damage, disorienting for 5s on a shield break, and AoE disorienting enemies in a 5m radius on a matching shield break. If you're interested, he name Zealot's Reward connects to the tragic lore of the fireteam of Rekkana, Yardarm-4, and Lisbon-13, who were seduced by the Black Garden. "Zealot" reflects their fanatical, corrupting obsession with the Garden's power, and the "reward" is the darkness artifacts and power they obtained, before turning on each other. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Charge Time or Backup Mag mod, or your preferred choice to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 125 from 3 December 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0unzzecMfqDsL3nxHGSQsp?si=d40055092caa4fa1) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing groups of Minors in general, and end-game underleveled content. As a rapid-fire FR, Zealot's Reward is in a good subfamily for damage output, and reloads with a ×0.8 animation scalar when empty. At base the stats are solid, apart from having lower ammo reserves - 22 Range equates to 15.10m when ADS and 11.62m hipfire, 56 Handling equates to a 0.42s ready, 0.32s ADS and 0.28s stow time, and 48 Reload Speed is a 2.02s reload. The battery has 7 shots (8 max) and with 0/1/2/3 Reserves mods, total ammo is 19/21/24/25 (max 25). To land all your bolts, you'll need to control the terrible 49 recoil direction wit your barrel perk - Arrowhead Brake is the best way of doing that on controller, although you can probably get away with Fluted Barrel on M+KB. You can control the recoil further with Particle Repeater or push out the range with Projection Fuse as the battery perk. For clearing groups of adds, the trait perk combination of Subsistence to reload a shot (2 when enhanced) on kills, and Reservoir Burst for a ×1.25 damage boost and AoE detonation on kill, as well as maximising the battery size to 8, work well. The Photoinhibition origin trait is very strong for PvE - a ×1.343 damage boost against barriers and elemental shields and ×1.216 against combatant overshields plus disorienting your target and, if matched with the shield type adds nearby too for 7s. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Quick Access Sling mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Void Breaches or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Zealot's Reward was never really a strong fusion in PvE. Controlled Burst and Reservoir Burst are your best perks in the fourth column, while the latter doesn't have a good pairing to overflow the magazine to get more shots without also getting kills. Lead from Gold will work best coupled with another Lead from Gold Kinetic/Stasis/Strand weapon. An interesting combination is Reservoir Burst and Destabilizing Rounds to spread Volatile and explosions." Recommended MW: Charge Time.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Under Pressure and Closing Time go together like peanut butter and jelly. At the bottom of the mag you have the best benefits of both perks. Both of which truly enhance the weapon feel and consistency. If you slide around a lot you can opt for Kickstart but without Slideshot or Slideways it might feel like it's lacking somewhere." Recommended MW: Range or Charge Time.

[YeezyGT's S15] (PvE): [MW: Stability] "With the right rolls, the Zealot's Reward can unseat Null Composure -- if you need a [Void] Fusion Rifle for higher-level content. Null is a stat monster though - so your benefits come from being able to roll Liquid Coils, the Under Pressure/High Impact Reserves combo, or Shield Disorient/Disruption Break. The former is fantastic for sustained damage, the latter for area control. Unfortunately, the recoil direction on this will always be poor -- invest highly in Stability for your best chance at counteracting this ((Higher stability = tighter bolt spread - far more important than Range for Fusion Rifles))"
